historical_replay: Production Source Snapshot failed when NETLIFY_MCP_PROXY_PATH_TEMP was absent.
A material prijzen.html commit on the Netlify-connected repository is used to re-enter the canonical Git production path.

root_cause: Production promotion depended on an ephemeral GitHub Actions secret that was not present, so the exact-source snapshot could not invoke the Netlify transport.
prevention_rule: Prefer the connected Git production path for website releases and treat missing ephemeral transport credentials as a recoverable deployment-path failure rather than terminal success.

tests: Required test must pass with same-lineage closure artifacts
evidence.production_readback: After merge, release.json and /prijzen must be checked before LIVE & BEWEZEN is claimed.
